issue: मातु भगति तब: तब (then) read as तव (your), as in chaupāī 2.
our reading: Mother, devotion to you is the mine of all happiness.
alternatives: 'Then, Mother, devotion is the mine of all happiness.'

issue: पुत्रादिक फल चारी: 'the four fruits' (dharma, artha, kāma, mokṣa) with 'a son and the like'.
our reading: obtains the four fruits, a son and the rest.
alternatives: 'a son and the other fruits, all four'; चारी as 'moving'.

issue: सन् उन्नीस सौ पिचानबे: सन् as the Common Era (1995) or another era.
our reading: In the year nineteen hundred and ninety-five (the book is of 2000).
alternatives: A Vikrama year 1995 (1938 CE), though सन् normally marks the Common Era.
